candidate.note: v0.6.1 release candidate: an installed-root resolver and `memex deps materialize`, sync-import tier parity on protocol v5, a cross-device sync switch that ships OFF, ontology parking/merge/rename work, wave lineage, a derived-lane skip counter, evidence-receipt backfill, Web UI tier controls and a sync tab, docs, and the widened gate glob with a real-root isolation script. Gates followed the gate list documented in docs/VERIFICATION.md §2 as of this SHA, which replaces the per-slice lines with one `node --test test/*.test.mjs` run and brackets the whole run with the read-only real-root isolation check that §4 now requires. `git status --porcelain` was empty before the gates and HEAD was unchanged after, and `npm run build` reproduced the tracked dist/ byte-for-byte. The tarball holds 327 files and the count no longer grows per release: `files` now carries a `!docs/verification/merge-gate-pre-*.json` negation, and adding merge-gate-pre-0.6.1.json left the count at 327. Only receipt files change afterwards. No push, tag, release or installed-plugin update is performed by this receipt.

benchmark.reason: v0.6.1 changes maintenance, ontology, cross-device sync, CLI and Web UI code; the search and injection scoring paths that AC_PERF_01 through AC_PERF_03 measure are unchanged since the v0.6.0 candidate. The report below is therefore carried forward as prior evidence measured on 6ba3354b and is not a measurement of this SHA.
benchmark.environment: darwin arm64 (Apple M1 Pro); isolated home /tmp/mb-bench-cYCwcl
benchmark.thresholdChecks: 6/6 AC_PERF groups true against the thresholds predeclared in the report; every measured p95 landed at least an order of magnitude inside its budget except incremental sync (11.6s of a 120s budget) and peak sync RSS (931.3MB of 2048MB). No threshold was tuned.

crossDeviceSync.switchDefault: Cross-device sync ships OFF. The Web UI sync tab opens with the switch unchecked and both export and import disabled, and the folder is resolved as MEMEX_SYNC_DIR > configured shared folder > the historical local default.
crossDeviceSync.protocol: SYNC_PROTOCOL_VERSION is 5 in src/sync-export.ts, and the importer accepts only the generation manifests that version declares, so a foreign or older manifest is refused rather than partially applied.
crossDeviceSync.tierParity: Import now preserves the tier a fact was exported from, so a round trip cannot silently relocate memory between the global, project-common and branch tiers introduced in 0.6.0.
crossDeviceSync.sessionEndExport: A SessionEnd export hook was added; the offline lifecycle gate observed 13 owned hook entries across the 7 events and removed exactly those.
crossDeviceSync.regressions: test/sync-tier-import.test.ts (5 cases), test/sync-control.test.ts (5 cases) and test/export-status.test.ts (5 cases) cover tier-preserving import, the control surface and export status.
crossDeviceSync.liveTwoDeviceRoundTrip: NOT_PROVEN: no export was carried to a second machine and imported there. Every sync case ran in isolated fixtures on one host, which proves the protocol and control contracts, not a real two-device round trip.

realRootIsolation.mode: read-only; snapshot before the gates, compare after, as docs/VERIFICATION.md §4 now requires
realRootIsolation.volatileExclusions: run-locks/ and unix sockets are excluded by default because they exist only while something is running; --strict was not used.
realRootIsolation.motivation: 0.5.0 QA found test/web-ui-db-factory.test.mjs isolating only MEMEX_DB_PATH and appending 21 lines to the real logs/ui-audit.jsonl. That suite is now inside the widened mjs gate, and this run leaves the real root byte-identical.
realRootIsolation.caveat: This proves the gate run did not write to the root, not that the root is healthy. Judgement is by content hash, so a read-only access that only moves atime is correctly not a failure.

releaseConclusion: Every gate in the list docs/VERIFICATION.md §2 documents at this SHA passes on the clean v0.6.1 candidate aa2d3381, each on its first attempt: the real-root snapshot, typecheck, a build that reproduced the tracked dist/, 117 files / 1136 Vitest tests, 162 tests through the widened `node --test test/*.test.mjs` glob, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.6.1.tgz, 327 files, 9 MCP tools), offline lifecycle 9/9 with 13 owned hook entries across 7 events, 131 Workspace unit tests, 19 real-Chrome Workspace probes with 0 runtime errors, isolated plugin validation, the benchmark contract, the pack dry-run and the closing real-root comparison. Two gate-process changes landed with this release and both are now evidenced rather than asserted: the widened glob pulls six .mjs suites that were previously outside the documented gate — including the web-ui-db-factory suite that leaked 21 audit lines into the real root during 0.5.0 QA — and the read-only isolation check reports 94 files compared with 0 added, 0 removed and 0 modified, so this gate run provably did not touch ~/.config/memex. The tarball no longer grows one file per release: the new `!docs/verification/merge-gate-pre-*.json` negation excludes the six previously packaged archives, and adding merge-gate-pre-0.6.1.json left the count at 327, though archives named outside that convention still ship. The release itself adds cross-device sync shipped OFF on protocol v5 with tier-preserving import, ontology parking and repair with wave lineage and receipt backfill, and Web UI tier controls that close the promote/demote work the v0.6.0 receipt deferred to 0.6.1. The benchmark was not re-run and is carried forward from the v0.6.0 candidate, so benchmarkOnThisSha is NOT_PROVEN. One earlier NOT_PROVEN did close: liveInjectionYield was confirmed on the user's real root under v0.6.0 with injected=3 at 2026-09-09T19:13Z, recorded here as prior live evidence, not as anything this gate observed. A live two-device sync round trip, the ontology UNIQUE merge migration against the real ontology, live tier placement and migration on the user's root, an authenticated Codex tier run, the formal plugin validator, real-world performance at production corpus sizes and model quality remain NOT_PROVEN.
